scenes.text: Imagine relaxing on a calm, shallow lake when suddenly, a giant one-hundred-and-fifty-foot oil rig right next to you starts tilting, snaps its cables, and completely disappears into the water.
You are witnessing the single most expensive drilling mistake in human history, where a tiny mathematical miscalculation pierced a massive, active salt mine directly beneath the lakebed.
This blunder created a monstrous, swirling whirlpool that violently swallowed eleven giant barges, an entire tugboat, the drilling platform, and seventy acres of the surrounding forest.
Incredibly, every single worker escaped the disaster alive, but if you were in their shoes, would you have run away immediately or stayed to film it, so hit follow and let me know in the comments!
